parameter.label: P_EMPRESA : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT EMP.CODEMP AS VALUE, EMP.CODEMP || ' - ' || EMP.RAZAOSOCIAL AS LABEL FROM TSIEMP EMP ORDER BY EMP.CODEMP

grid.title: Qualificação - visão legada
grid.expression: WITH RESUMO AS ( SELECT C.CODEMP, E.CGC, E.RAZAOSOCIAL, MIN(C.DTNEG) AS DT_NF_ANTIGA, MAX(C.DTNEG) AS DT_NF_RECENTE, SUM(CASE WHEN T.CODMODDOC = 55 AND T.NFE IN ('N','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_NFE_PROP, SUM(CASE WHEN T.CODMODDOC = 55 AND T.NFE = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_NFE_TERC, SUM(CASE WHEN T.CODMODDOC = 1 AND T.NFSE = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_NFSE_PROP, SUM(CASE WHEN T.CODMODDOC = 1 AND T.NFSE = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_NFSE_TERC, SUM(CASE WHEN (T.CODMODDOC IN (57,67) OR T.CTE IS NOT NULL) AND T.CTE = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_CTE_PROP, SUM(CASE WHEN (T.CODMODDOC IN (57,67) OR T.CTE IS NOT NULL) AND T.CTE = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_CTE_TERC FROM TGFCAB C INNER JOIN TSIEMP E ON E.CODEMP = C.CODEMP INNER JOIN TGFTOP T ON T.CODTIPOPER = C.CODTIPOPER AND T.DHALTER = C.DHTIPOPER WHERE C.TIPMOV <> 'Z' AND (:P_DATA_INI IS NULL OR C.DTNEG >= :P_DATA_INI) AND (:P_DATA_FIM IS NULL OR C.DTNEG <= :P_DATA_FIM) AND (:P_EMPRESA IS NULL OR C.CODEMP IN (:P_EMPRESA)) GROUP BY C.CODEMP, E.CGC, E.RAZAOSOCIAL ) SELECT CODEMP, CGC, RAZAOSOCIAL, DT_NF_ANTIGA, DT_NF_RECENTE, QTD_NFE_PROP, QTD_NFE_TERC, QTD_NFSE_PROP, QTD_NFSE_TERC, QTD_CTE_PROP, QTD_CTE_TERC FROM RESUMO ORDER BY CODEMP
